name: Garrick's Head
summary: Garrick's Head is the severed head of Garrick Padfoot, a notorious cutthroat operating near the vineyards of Northshire Valley. It serves as gruesome proof of death to claim a bounty issued by the authorities at Northshire Abbey.

sections.title: A Bandit's End
sections.body: For weeks, Garrick Padfoot and his gang of thugs harassed local farmers and merchants across Northshire Valley. Taking advantage of the Kingdom of Stormwind's stretched defenses, Garrick holed up in a shack near the Northshire vineyards, raiding passing trade. With local guards pinned down by encroaching kobolds and Defias bandits, Deputy Willem placed a bounty on Padfoot's head, seeking an enterprising adventurer to eliminate the outlaw and present undeniable proof of his demise.

faq.answer: Garrick Padfoot was a villainous cutthroat who terrorized the farmers, vineyards, and traveling merchants of Northshire Valley. He established a small outpost with a crew of thugs east of Northshire Abbey across the river.

faq.q: Why is a severed head needed to collect the bounty?
faq.answer: Frontier justice in Elwynn Forest demands irrefutable proof. Deputy Willem and the Northshire authorities require tangible evidence of Garrick's demise before handing out the bounty payment.
Padfoot established a camp at a small wooden shack located east of Northshire Abbey, across the river bridge near the Northshire vineyards.

faq.q: Who pays the bounty for Garrick's head?
faq.answer: Deputy Willem, stationed just outside the entrance to Northshire Abbey, posted the bounty and pays it out upon receiving the head.

angles.text: Taking Padfoot's head marks one of the first decisive blows a young Stormwind recruit lands against the lawlessness creeping through Elwynn Forest.
Eliminating Padfoot demonstrates to local ruffians that undisciplined banditry will not go unanswered by deadlier, more professional blades.
